description: Captures the reference DOOM 1.9 main-menu-open state after a single ESC key press from the title screen. Pins the input event (key-down/key-up of key 1 = M_KEY_ESCAPE per Chocolate Doom 2.2.1) and the framebuffer hash plus state snapshot taken one tic after the menu becomes interactive. Initial entries are empty and require an external reference run.
captureMethod: Launch doom/DOOM.EXE -iwad doom/DOOM1.WAD via the 02-003 sandbox, wait for title screen stable (per 02-016/02-017), inject ESCAPE key-down then key-up via the 02-010 injection oracle, advance one tic, then capture both the framebuffer (per 02-011) and the state snapshot (per 02-012) and the next-tic audio window (per 02-013).

inputScript.description: ESCAPE key-down opens the main menu
